name: Bounded project topic recovery
summary: Read-only endpoint/client lexical recovery from one authorized project snapshot. Own-kind record/current-checkpoint/review readers, permission before corpus statistics, scope/query/visible-generation cursors and final live principal check. Five default/twenty max; bounded text/answer/corpus and cooperative two-second compute budget. Every hit trust:data with full-source hash and escaped excerpt; no pointer I/O, index writes, inferred approval, semantic answers or HTTP route.
